messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert: customer-acme private VPN (vpn-acme-eu) high packet loss and BGP withdraws observed in eu-west-2. Error rate on egress to 10.8.0.0/16 spiking > 30% over 5m. Pager: P1 - Private connectivity
sara-oncall: acked, I'm on it. taking ownership — I'll stand up a war room. @kevin-oncall can you join? :eyes:
kevin-oncall: joining. grabbing recent graphs now.
mike-net: saw similar in cloud provider console — multiple withdraws from peer ASN 64521 at ~18:42 UTC. Could be flapping in az eu-west-2b.
alice-sre: impact? which customer endpoints affected? amy-support, any CS tickets?
amy-support: customer-acme reported app errors at 18:40 UTC, level=sev2. They see timeouts and 502s for their internal APIs that go over the VPN.
bob-sales: pinged customer contact (J. Patel) — they're seeing degraded behavior; asking for ETA.
kevin-oncall: adding quick impact note: ~12% of customer sessions failed across two regions, concentrated on eu-west-2 AZ b.
sara-oncall: plan: 1) verify if this is provider side AZ network issue 2) attempt failover to alternate tunnel/Direct Connect path 3) temporarily route around by advertising /16 via backup peering 4) escalate to GCP support if BGP persists
mike-net: running traceroute from our egress host:
```
traceroute to 10.8.2.1 (10.8.2.1), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.100.0.1  0.7 ms  0.6 ms  0.6 ms
 2  35.190.0.14  1.2 ms  1.1 ms  1.2 ms
 3  * * *
 4  * * *
 5  34.123.45.78  7.1 ms  7.2 ms  7.0 ms
```
mike-net: lots of * after hop 2 — suggests blackholing or provider transit issue. Also fetching BGP table from our side.
kevin-oncall: BGP show neighbors for peer 203.0.113.5:
```
Neighbor 203.0.113.5, ASN 64521, state: Established
Prefixes received 34 -> 0 (withdraws seen at 18:42:13)
LastError: hold timer expired
```
sara-oncall: @cloud-gcp can you confirm if there is an AZ maintenance or known fabric issue in eu-west-2b? cloud-gcp: pinged GCP incidents channel.
cloud-gcp: GCP console: "Intermittent packet loss affecting select VM-to-customer cross-connects in eu-west-2b. Mitigation in progress. Support case #INC-78902 opened." — they advise withdraw/reannounce may take time.
alice-sre: because this is private connectivity, reroute via backup tunnel now. mike-net: can you trigger failover to vpn-acme-eu-backup? Steps in runbook: `/scripts/vpn/failover --customer acme --to backup`.
mike-net: running failover now.
```
$ /scripts/vpn/failover --customer acme --to backup
initiating failover for customer-acme
bringing up tunnel vpn-acme-eu-bkp -> success
reannouncing routes via backup peer
```
mike-net: backup tunnel came up, BGP session with backup ASN 64522 established. We see route propagation within 35s.
amy-support: customer reports partial recovery at 18:51 UTC: some APIs respond again. They still see occasional errors on long tails.
kevin-oncall: monitoring: packet loss dropped from 32% -> 3% after failover. latency stable.
sara-oncall: good. we're going to keep the backup route for now and coordinate with GCP to monitor kernel-level drops. Also opening a follow-up ticket to request root cause and ETA for full path fix.
bob-sales: shared update with customer: told them we failed over to backup and monitoring. They asked about a postmortem and SLA credits — escalating to CS for next steps.
amy-support: created ticket ACME-9876 in support queue with full timeline and contact info.
cloud-gcp: GCP support updated: fabric issue isolated to an overloaded transit switch in eu-west-2b, fix ETA 2h. They will not automatically reannounce withdrawn prefixes; recommends keeping backup route until confirmed.
sara-oncall: decision: leave backup active, block auto-revert, monitor for 2 hours. I'll schedule a handoff at 20:00 UTC. @kevin-oncall please prepare notes for on-call shift change.
kevin-oncall: notes copied to incident doc and pinned in channel. prepping graphs.
alice-sre: will run an eval against our KV-cache to ensure no data consistency issues due to asymmetric path. running smoke tests.
alice-sre: smoke tests: ok. minor slow tails on long-poll endpoints but within SLO now.
incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-2026, severity: P1 -> active, owner: sara-oncall, runbook: /incidents/INC-2026
sara-oncall: handing off to kevin-oncall at 20:00 UTC — I'll be on standby for follow-up. Summary: provider fabric issue in eu-west-2b caused BGP withdraws for peer ASN 64521; we failed over to backup tunnel and restored majority of traffic. Customer impacted: ACME corp, partial outage ~11 minutes, degraded for ~30m. Next: postmortem + RCA with GCP.
kevin-oncall: ack, taking it from here. will ping team 15m before handover. :thumbsup:
bob-sales: thanks team. I'll coordinate the customer comms doc with CS.
amy-support: adding remediation checklist to incident doc and opening a PS engagement if customer asks.
incidents-bot: Note: Please fill out the incident form: /forms/incident-summary/INC-2026
sara-oncall: +1 — copying key logs into incident doc now. good job everyone. :clap:
mike-net: FYI we saw route flap counter increment ~4 times before failover; saving BGP logs and will attach.
alice-sre: tagging this for follow-up on service resilience: consider automated health check + quicker failover for privateconnect customers.
customer-acme: thx for fast response. we'll wait for PM to sync on postmortem. agreed keep backup active.
kevin-oncall: closing live remediation thread; will keep channel open for updates from GCP. last update 20:22 UTC.
